prompts.title: 电影感街头人像摄影
prompts.description: 一个用于 Gemini Nano Banana 2 的提示，根据上传的图像生成一张高分辨率、电影感的年轻男子中景特写肖像。主体看向别处，戴着徒步旅行者墨镜和一件厚重的黑色连帽夹克，显眼的腕表清晰可见。背景是一个高度模糊的城市交通枢纽，采用冷色调、漫射光和高对比度，营造出一种忧郁的氛围。
prompts.content: A high-resolution, cinematic medium close-up portrait of a young man in the uploaded image. He is looking away from the camera in a three-quarter profile toward the left, projecting a contemplative or moody expression. He is wearing classic black Wayfarer-style sunglasses with glossy acetate frames and dark lenses and a heavy, matte black hooded jacket made of a suede-like or thick cotton material. The fabric features deep, soft folds and a visible silver metal zipper track. A prominent stainless steel wristwatch with a silver link bracelet and a dark circular face is visible on his left wrist, which is raised toward his chest. Background: A heavily blurred (shallow depth of field) urban transit hub or train station. Dark industrial steel beams and trusses are visible in the upper frame. Indistinct, glowing orange and white terminal signage creates a soft bokeh effect. Lighting: Soft, diffused ambient lighting with a cool color temperature (approx. 6000K). The light hits the right side of his face (viewer's left), creating gentle transitions into deep shadows on the opposite side. Framing: Eye-level, centered-left composition with a focus on textures—the skin’s pores, the hair’s strands, and the fabric’s grain. Professional street photography, cinematic mood. Muted tones, high contrast, dominant blacks and charcoal grays with cool blue-gray undertones. 85mm f/1.8 prime lens equivalent.

prompts.title: 想象力变为现实的电影级 3D 插画
prompts.description: 一个给 Google Nano Banana 2 的详细提示，用于生成一张皮克斯/迪士尼风格的电影级 3D 插画，描绘一个可爱的卡通男孩从螺旋式速写本中走出，置身于一张温暖的木质书桌上，将 2D 草图线条与生动的 3D 角色融为一体。
prompts.content:
Cinematic 3D illustration of imagination coming to life. A cute young cartoon boy is stepping out of a spiral sketchbook placed on a warm wooden desk in a cozy creative workspace. The sketchbook page contains a pencil sketch drawing of the same boy, labeled at the top “MY WORLD – SKETCHES.” The drawing is simple graphite line art, while the real character emerging from it is rendered in fully detailed 3D animated style.

The boy looks identical to the drawing but transformed into a vibrant 3D character, with soft rounded facial features, big expressive eyes, fluffy brown hair, and a gentle friendly smile. He is wearing a casual raglan t-shirt (white with blue sleeves), denim jeans, and red sneakers.

One foot is still on the sketchbook page while the other steps onto the wooden desk, creating the illusion that he is coming to life directly from the drawing. The sketch lines subtly fade where the character emerges, blending 2D pencil art into 3D reality.

The desk around the notebook is filled with creative tools: scattered colored pencils, graphite pencils, pens, sketching tools, and erasers. A ceramic mug holding paintbrushes and pencils sits nearby with the text “CREATIVE TOOLS” printed on it.

The background shows a warm cozy artist studio environment, with soft bokeh fairy lights, shelves with books and art supplies, and a corkboard covered with colorful sticky notes pinned behind the desk. The lighting is warm golden evening light, creating cinematic depth, soft shadows, and glowing highlights.

Composition & camera
•slightly low angle perspective
•focus on the boy stepping forward
•shallow depth of field
•foreground desk details sharp, background softly blurred

Style
•Pixar / Disney-style 3D character design
•ultra detailed textures
•soft global illumination
•photoreal desk materials
•stylized animated character

Quality keywords
masterpiece, ultra detailed, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, global illumination, depth of field, volumetric light, ray-traced reflections, warm color grading, storytelling composition, Pixar-quality 3D render, magical realism, imagination coming to life

⸻

blurry, low resolution, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, bad hands, messy sketch lines, flat lighting, dull colors, watermark, text artifacts
prompts.translatedContent:
想象力变为现实的电影级 3D 插画。一个可爱的卡通小男孩正从一本螺旋装订的素描本中走出来，这本素描本放在一个舒适创意工作区里的温暖木质书桌上。素描本的页面上画着同一个小男孩的铅笔素描，顶部标有“MY WORLD – SKETCHES”（我的世界 – 素描）。画作是简单的石墨线条艺术，而从中走出来的真实角色则以完全细致的 3D 动画风格呈现。

这个小男孩与画中的形象一模一样，但已转化为一个充满活力的 3D 角色，拥有柔和圆润的面部特征、大而富有表现力的眼睛、蓬松的棕色头发和温柔友善的笑容。他穿着一件休闲的插肩 T 恤（白色配蓝色袖子）、牛仔裤和红色运动鞋。

他的一只脚仍踩在素描本页面上，另一只脚则迈向木质书桌，营造出他直接从画中活过来的错觉。素描线条在角色出现的地方微妙地淡化，将 2D 铅笔画融入 3D 现实。

笔记本周围的书桌上摆满了创意工具：散落的彩色铅笔、石墨铅笔、钢笔、素描工具和橡皮擦。一个陶瓷马克杯里插着画笔和铅笔，杯子上印有“CREATIVE TOOLS”（创意工具）字样，放在旁边。

背景展示了一个温暖舒适的艺术家工作室环境，有柔和的散景小彩灯、摆满书籍和艺术用品的架子，以及书桌后面钉满了彩色便签的软木板。灯光是温暖的金色傍晚光线，营造出电影般的景深、柔和的阴影和发光的亮点。

构图与镜头
• 略微低角度透视
• 聚焦于向前迈步的小男孩
• 浅景深
• 前景书桌细节清晰，背景柔和模糊

风格
• 皮克斯 / 迪士尼风格的 3D 角色设计
• 超精细纹理
• 柔和的全局照明
• 照片级写实的书桌材质
• 风格化的动画角色

质量关键词
杰作，超精细，8k 分辨率，电影级灯光，全局照明，景深，体积光，光线追踪反射，暖色调，叙事构图，皮克斯品质 3D 渲染，魔幻现实主义，想象力变为现实

⸻

可选负面提示（适用于扩散模型）
模糊，低分辨率，解剖结构扭曲，多余肢体，糟糕的手部，凌乱的素描线条，扁平光照，暗淡色彩，水印，文本伪影
